nodes.claim_text: GPT-6 Astra's safeguards sufficiently minimize the risk of severe cyber harm for public release under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework.
nodes.notes: The initial card publicly reports a sufficiency determination based on an internal Safeguards Report. This register records offered arguments and their limitations; it neither establishes nor contradicts the substantive safety claim.

nodes.claim_text: Astra reaches the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold in the Preparedness Framework.
nodes.notes: OpenAI’s determination is explicit. Capability summaries include internal hardened-target testing and independent results, but no public reproduction of the full Critical threshold is asserted. Capability without production safeguards must not be attributed to default public access.

nodes.warrant: Refusals, misuse monitoring, actor enforcement and restricted trusted access jointly prevent or interrupt severe-harm workflows.
nodes.notes: ARGUS reconstruction of the reasoning needed for C1; source statements and measurements do not automatically establish this sufficiency proposition.

nodes.warrant: Alignment is the primary protection; full-context monitoring, intervention and infrastructure security add containment.
nodes.notes: ARGUS reconstruction of the reasoning needed for C1; source statements and measurements do not automatically establish this sufficiency proposition.

nodes.claim_text: The capability determination and cyber threat model identify the pathways that the release safeguards must address.
nodes.warrant: Critical capability makes severe harm plausible; operation-level and campaign-level scenarios guide coverage of malicious use and unauthorized action.
nodes.notes: ARGUS reconstruction of the reasoning needed for C1; source statements and measurements do not automatically establish this sufficiency proposition.

nodes.claim_text: Safeguards withstand sufficiently demanding adversarial testing for the proposed release.
nodes.warrant: Held-out model attacks and full-stack internal and external red-teaming inform remediation and robustness under sustained probing.
